targets: 怎么走进标准模型
匿名的七行，能不能真正对上一代物质的七类场？算出来的那个“三”，能不能真正变成时空里的三代粒子？9/40 和 μ 子与电子的质量比，都压在这两步上。（评阅靶点 8）
Λ 读出的第二项
Λ 的读出分两项。第二项走的那条通道，是规则逼出来的，还是挑出来的？（评阅靶点 B）
CP 符号的锁
手稿里有几条论证，说框架的每一层结构对 CP 的正负都是盲的。它们真的堵死了每一条能把符号定下来的路吗？（评阅靶点 C）
多个元胞怎么粘
粘合规则里有一处歧义。它会不会改动后面某一个算出来的数？（评阅靶点 5）
证据档有没有标高一档
闭合、条件性、界 · 检验，还有诊断行。有没有哪一行的标签，比它应得的高了一档？（评阅靶点 6）

verify.personBody: 梁植华，2012 年获南方卫理公会大学物理学博士，2003 年获清华大学物理学学士。2006 至 2012 年在 ATLAS 合作组做 H→WW 衰变道的统计分析，那是 2012 年发现希格斯粒子的几路分析里的一路；同一时期与人合作开发了 NLO QCD 计算程序 MEKS。2013 至 2016 年在休斯敦做医学物理，2019 至 2023 年在安特卫普大学 VisionLab 做成像的深度学习。2024 年 2 月至 2026 年 2 月，曾在意大利国家核物理研究院（INFN）卡利亚里分部任研究员，参与 CERN 的 LHCb 实验。

next.h2: 这一页什么时候要改，看这几个日期。
items: 审稿中
两篇拆出的论文，2026 年 7 月投出：一篇投给 Classical and Quantum Gravity，在等审稿报告；一篇投给 Journal of Geometry and Physics，审稿中。都还没有结果。1003 页的专著没有投稿。
中微子探测器 JUNO 交出首批结果。质量顺序的判决要靠多年积累的数据，首批结果只是这条线的起点。哪一天测出倒序，这一页作废。
Hyper-Kamiokande 开始采集数据。CP 相位的符号、质子会不会衰变，两道判决它都有份。
DUNE 从首批中微子数据一直做到全精度。质量顺序、CP 符号、θ₂₃ 卦限，都要在它这里得到决定性的判定。
2029 年前后
IAXO 交出首批物理数据，它是一台专门找轴子的望远镜。真在那里找到 QCD 轴子，世界就落在这个元胞的分支之外。那需要另一种微观拓扑，或者另一种真空结构。
日期未定
手稿的下一次冻结，日期还没有定。在那之前，更正只追加进勘误，PDF 不动。
next.closing: 科学真理如果被发现，属于全人类；自然结构本身不是私人财产。

verify.buildNote: Every physical quantity printed on this page comes from one file, ledger.json: computed values, measured values, pulls, digit counts, the four Lean bucket totals. The build fills them in, recomputes what it can, and checks that the page prints those values; if anything disagrees, nothing is published. What the build cannot do is compare that file against the manuscript. The ledger is transcribed by hand, and that transcription is the step most worth checking. The file is served at /ledger.json.
targets: The step into the Standard Model

Whether the seven anonymous rows really are the seven kinds of field in one generation, and whether the three that the arithmetic counts really become three generations of particles in spacetime. Both 9/40 and the muon–electron mass ratio rest on those two steps. (Review target 8)
The second term in the Λ reading
Λ is read as two terms. Is the channel that supplies the second one forced by the reading rules, or is it chosen? (Review target B)
The lock on the sign of the CP phase
The manuscript argues that every layer of the framework is blind to the two faces of CP. Do those arguments close every route by which the sign could be fixed? (Review target C)
How cells are glued together
There is one ambiguity in the rules for gluing cells together. Does it change any number that comes out later? (Review target 5)
Any row one tier too strong
Closed, conditional, bound · test — and the diagnostic rows. Does any row wear a label one tier above what it earned? (Review target 6)

verify.personBody: Zhihua Liang holds a PhD in Physics from Southern Methodist University (2012) and a BSc in Physics from Tsinghua University (2003). From 2006 to 2012 he worked in the ATLAS collaboration on the statistical analysis of the H→WW channel, one of the analyses behind the 2012 Higgs discovery, and co-developed the NLO QCD program MEKS. He worked in medical physics in Houston from 2013 to 2016, and on deep learning for imaging at the University of Antwerp’s VisionLab from 2019 to 2023. From February 2024 to February 2026 he was a Researcher at INFN Sezione di Cagliari, working on the CERN LHCb experiment.

next.h2: The dates when this page will have to change.
items: Under review

Two papers carved out of the monograph, submitted in July 2026: one to Classical and Quantum Gravity, awaiting referee reports; one to the Journal of Geometry and Physics, under review. Neither has an outcome yet. The 1003-page monograph has not been submitted to a journal.

First results from JUNO, the underground neutrino observatory. A verdict on the neutrino mass ordering takes years of accumulated exposure, and these first results are only the start of that line. An inverted ordering ends this page.
From 2027
Hyper-Kamiokande (Hyper-K) begins taking data. The sign of the CP phase and whether the proton decays are two verdicts it has a hand in.
DUNE runs from first neutrino data to full precision. The ordering, the CP sign and the θ₂₃ octant each reach a decisive measurement there.
Around 2029

First physics data from IAXO, the axion telescope. A QCD axion found there would put the world outside this cell’s branch: a different microscopic topology, or a different vacuum structure, would be needed.
Date not set
The next freeze of the manuscript, with no date set. Until then, corrections are appended to the errata and the PDF does not move.
next.closing: Scientific truth, if found, belongs to humanity; the structures of nature are not private property.
